beats.headline: Highway car wash owner comes to the boardwalk
beats.body: The owner of the roadside car wash has bought the old ice-cream kiosk by the sea. The car wash back home keeps running under its manager.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: Tourists don't wait like drivers do. Keep the line short and the cones cold.

beats.headline: Kiosk hires its first scooper
beats.body: Two hands behind the counter now. The line on the boardwalk moves at last.

beats.headline: Plans for the pier take shape
beats.body: The kiosk owner has bought the old pier. Locals expect snack bars, surf rentals and a beach motel before long.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: One kiosk was a start. A whole boardwalk is a business.
